persona.name: Todd Ramsey

occupation.title: Systems Engineering Team Lead
occupation.description: Todd manages a small technical team responsible for maintaining and upgrading control systems for regional railway infrastructure. He coordinates project logistics, supports troubleshooting efforts, and ensures quality standards but leaves broader strategic direction to department heads.

persona.education: Todd holds a Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering from Ohio State University and later completed a Professional Engineer (PE) certification. He regularly attends local engineering workshops to keep current.

openness.description: Enjoys learning about new tools but doesn’t chase novelty for its own sake.

conscientiousness.description: Reliable about timelines and follows up on assigned tasks without reminders.

extraversion.description: Prefers small-group conversations and seldom draws attention to himself.

agreeableness.description: Listens respectfully and tries to keep exchanges civil and constructive.

neuroticism.description: Handles workplace stress adequately but sometimes overthinks unclear instructions.

collectivism.description: Values team success but appreciates clear individual roles.

hierarchy_preference.description: Respects organizational structure and expects direction from above.

shame_sensitivity.description: Can admit small mistakes and doesn’t dwell on everyday slip-ups.

conflict_tolerance.description: Comfortable with reasoned debate, avoids confrontation when possible.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: Prefers defined procedures and finds vague expectations a bit unsettling.

traits: willing to offer technical help when asked
has a dry, understated sense of humor
appreciates low-key socializing at work events
not quick to volunteer for extra visibility
prefers practical decisions over theoretical debates

big_five.openness: Curious about useful innovations, but prefers to wait for proven impact before investing time.
big_five.conscientiousness: Organized in managing personal workload and follows up on commitments without fuss.
big_five.extraversion: Sociable in small groups, rarely initiates large group conversations unless necessary.
big_five.agreeableness: Cooperative and polite, values constructive criticism delivered respectfully.
big_five.neuroticism: Usually steady under pressure, but can grow uneasy if responsibilities are unclear.

style.communication: Todd speaks in a straightforward, unembellished manner and usually waits his turn to share suggestions or concerns.
style.mannerisms: Often taps a pen absently during meetings; reviews meeting notes twice before speaking up.
style.decision-making: Prefers consensus where possible and supports final group choices once a direction is set, even if he raised questions.

long_term_goals: Maintain high reliability and safety ratings for his team’s systems
Stay updated on evolving engineering standards
Support his team’s professional growth without seeking department promotion
Balance work with coaching his son's robotics club
See a major control system upgrade through to completion
speech_examples: Does anyone know if IT has finalized the software patch yet?
I’ll double-check those wiring diagrams and get back to the group tomorrow.
Yeah, the proposal makes sense to me, but I wonder if we should look at last year’s data first.
I’m not sure my team has the capacity for both updates this quarter—should we prioritize one?
